---
title: "Getting started in user mode"
---

In **user mode** rig keeps everything inside your home directory, so **it never
needs `sudo` or an administrator account**. Use this on a machine where you do
not have administrator rights, or where you would rather not touch system
directories.

If you do administer the machine and want a conventional system-wide R, follow
[Getting started in admin mode](tutorial-admin.qmd) instead. For the trade-offs
between the two modes, see [Admin mode vs user
mode](admin-vs-user-mode.qmd).
